no_adcom_quote.quote: We decided not to take this application to the PDAC. There are several previously approved atypical antipsychotic agents similar in overall activity to iloperidone, and an evaluation of the safety data for iloperidone did not reveal particular safety issues that were so unexpected for a drug in this class as to justify a PDAC meeting. Furthermore, the design and results of the efficacy trials did not pose any unusual concerns that we could not address within our group. Overall, there were no sufficiently controversial issues that would have benefited, in my view, from advisory committee discussion.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for the FANAPT (iloperidone) NDA022192 approval. The Summary Review's dedicated PDAC section states the review team decided not to take the application to the Psychopharmacological Drugs Advisory Committee because iloperidone's efficacy and safety profile resembled already-approved atypical antipsychotics and raised no sufficiently controversial issues. The Office Director memo independently confirms the application 'did not raise issues needing advisory committee input,' so there are no AdCom-driven linkages to the approval.
